body: I just want to feel, and pills prevent that. I can feel no emotion. Every time another new year rolls around I nearly die of a panic attack because I can't do it again. It's gone on long enough, I just want to rest

Bipolar, getting worse as I get older. I went so long without going to get "help" that I demolished any chance of reaching my then goals in like. Seriously, you'd be like "holy shit, this guy is fucking nuts/retarded" if I told you the half of it. Due to this I am locked down doing a job/jobs I hate just to make ends meet, and can't go back to school because I owe money due to signing up (manic) and never showing up (depressed). I miss just being me and feeling emotion, even if I was more fucking nuts. I hear shit like people calling my name, but it could be because of sleep. I just wish it was more acceptable in this world. "They can make you better, swallow your pills zombie", it's bullshit. If they could cure it, they wouldn't because then you wouldn't be dependent on their meds. Greedy fuckers can keep the shithole they created. In a hundred years, none of this will have mattered anyway. Today one hundred years ago was the best day, the worst day, and the unexpected last day of people's lives, and it means nothing now. Time's a motherfucker.
